preliminary_attempts.description: PowerShell/native -c quoting caused Python SyntaxError in a one-off computed probe; no component runtime ran.

causes: Python sliced UTF-16 Babel offsets as Unicode code points.
Scalar computed staleness was hypothesized but native runtime produced the correct on value.
preliminary_attempts.resolution: Label offsets UTF-16 and decode correctly; retain the computed scenario as a passing control, not an invented defect.
